locations.label: Nacht Tesla control
locations.description: With all four engines active, use Nacht’s Tesla control when the giant Apothicon passes directly in front of the building. Enter its mouth after it is trapped. Shoot the three yellow tubes holding its heart to release Pack-a-Punch into the stomach. Return through the mouth to leave; the stomach is also used for the Arnie and egg steps. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Apothicon Pack-a-Punch
locations.description: With all four engines active, use Nacht’s Tesla control when the giant Apothicon passes directly in front of the building. Enter its mouth after it is trapped. locations.label: Upstairs Nacht shield bench
locations.description: Build the shield at Nacht’s upstairs bench. One part is in Origins: by the entrance from spawn, near Wunderfizz, or beside the truck. One is high on a wall in Der Eisendrache; activate the four pyramid plates and collect it during low gravity. The last is in Verrückt: the pillar near Speed Cola, the kitchen table or the corner room beyond the stairs. Keep a fresh shield before entering a trial or boss arena. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Spawn corruption engine
locations.description: At spawn, shoot the four marked gravestones in the order shown: second → third → first → fourth from left to right, corresponding to Richtofen, Dempsey, Takeo and Nikolai. A sound confirms the sequence. If it fails, start the full sequence again. Then activate and defend the corruption engines at spawn, Der Eisendrache, Mob of the Dead and Verrückt. Each costs 500 points and connects its region to Nacht. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
